segments.summary: Reviewed validate-all, readiness ordering, cleanup module and wrapper wiring, retention, and cleanup UX; found substitutable skill delivery, undefined workspace identity, unresolved run retention, and optional destructive-scope UX.

Reviewed shortcut and skill backend/enhancement checklists, completion verification, and risk register; found missing runner listing, concurrent-edit, completion-record, and evidence-writer protocols.

Reviewed cleanup signatures, root-state protection, non-git behavior, reset/workdir safety, exclude helper, evidence run definition, and manual worktree preview; key gaps are signature mismatch, exclude grammar, retention lineage, and optional preview.

Reviewed cleanup races/order, output locations, config projection, retired SDK behavior, GUI runtime projection, and shortcut guards; found unguarded races, missing allowlist registration, flexible config projection, and discretionary shortcut conflicts.

Reviewed skill compatibility, implementation risks, cross-plan ownership, worktree distinctions, and orchestrator/interview wrappers; found undefined enablement, stubbed delivery, weak cross-plan enforcement, and missing wrapper failure transitions.

Reviewed bounded output, cleanup crew coordination, lifecycle continuity, recovery-lineage preservation, cleanup actions, and debug restore points; all six units retain material protocol or transition gaps.

Reviewed temporary instrumentation, residue visibility, secret/profiler cleanup, retired migration bridge, structural recovery, and runner skill injection; found ungrounded instrumentation lifecycle, concurrency and secret gaps, plus a critical platform_specs contradiction.
